description_en: Queries the details of multiple delivery groups that meet specified conditions, without specifying a particular delivery group
description_zh: 查询多个交付组详细信息，即不指定特定的交付组，而是查询所有满足条件的交付组的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-app-instance-group --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --status Status.1_:_PUBLISHED_,_Status.2_:_FAILED --app-instance-group-id aig-9ciijz60n4xsv0000 --product-type CloudApp --app-instance-group-name '办公应用' --app-center-image-id img-8z4nztpaqvay40000 --appstream-center-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --node-instance-type appstreaming.vgpu.4c8g.2g --office-site-id cn-hongkong+dir-6430670000 --tag Value=design Key=department --user-group-ids example-string --excluded-user-group-ids example-string --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAppInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The number of query results per page. Maximum value: `100`
parameters.help_zh: 每页的查询结果数量，不可超过`100`
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query results to display
parameters.help_zh: 需展示的查询结果页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The list of delivery group statuses
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The delivery group name. Fuzzy matching is used for the query. For example, if you set the delivery group name to `OfficeApp`, all delivery groups whose names contain `OfficeApp` are returned, such as `MyOfficeApp` and `OfficeAppA`
parameters.help_zh: 交付组名称，查询时采用模糊匹配规则。例如，假设填写的交付组名称为`办公应用`，则名称中包含`办公应用`的交付组都会被查询到，例如名为`我的办公应用`、`办公应用A`的交付组
parameters.name: app_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: The application image ID. You can obtain this value from the Image Management page in the WUYING Cloud Application console
parameters.help_zh: 应用镜像ID，可从无影云应用控制台的镜像管理页面获取
parameters.name: app_center_image_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the delivery group. For more information about supported regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426036.html
parameters.help_zh: 交付组所属的地域ID。关于支持的地域详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426036.html
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The specification type ID of the purchased resource. You can call the [ListNodeInstanceType](~~ListNodeInstanceType~~) operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的规格类型ID。可通过[ListNodeInstanceType](~~ListNodeInstanceType~~)接口获取
parameters.name: node_instance_type

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The list of delivery group statuses
v1_body_parameters.name: Status
